verdict.rationale: Bolt supports exporting the project's code via GitHub (full history 'lives outside Bolt') and direct code editing/view, giving users an open-format path to leave with their code (bolt-docs-2, bolt-docs-31, bolt-docs-30, bolt-docs-25). However, there is no documented mechanism to export other data (e.g., Supabase database contents, chat history, project settings) in an open format, and no single 'export everything' feature is described. Missing for 10: full data export beyond code (database dumps, project metadata), documented open-format export of non-code assets, and independent confirmation of a clean, complete migration path.
